news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price gain to ₹20.25, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 8.2x. Average trailing P/E is 22x in the Diversified Financial industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 73% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.97 loss per share (vs ₹0.79 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.97 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.79 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.46m (up 123% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹5.16m (loss widened 37% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 34% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 26% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.15 (vs ₹0.16 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.15. Revenue: ₹12.0m (up ₹10.3m from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹799.0k (up 3.9% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.7% (down from 45% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss).
